Maya: quick sync — we need one tight copy arc for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages that maps to launch posts + webinar hooks + inbound routing
Tom: got it. do you want separate headlines per mode or a shared lead sentence + mode panels?
Maya: shared lead sentence, mode-specific micro-CTAs. keep hero: value-forward and ops-friendly.
Ana: +1. also want a short benchmark blurb we can reuse in launch posts — e.g. "<50ms median latency on common prompts" — but phrase without raw numbers maybe.
Sam: can we do three headline candidates each? quick A/B for the hero and then micro-CTAs for dedicated/private privacy language.
Jules: I drafted options. sharing snippets:
Jules: ```
Option A: Ship reliable LLM inference — hosted for speed, dedicated for scale, private for control.
Option B: Predictable inference, wherever you run it: hosted API, reserved capacity, private deployment.
Option C: From prototype to regulated production — the same API, tuned for cost and latency.
```
Maya: these are solid. option C resonates with enterprise audience.
Tom: for launch posts we should convert one sentence into a 2-line lede + 1-sentence benchmark callout + CTA to webinar signup
Ana: sample post lede: "Redwood Inference lets teams deploy fast, scale predictably, and meet compliance needs — with a single API. Join our webinar to see real latency and cost benchmarks."
Sam: inbound routing: add UTM for webinar leads vs. product trial leads. webinar leads -> sales nurture, trial leads -> product-led onboarding flow.
Maya: also want a short FAQ blurb for Private page about VPC/KMS — one-sentence, no jargon.
Jules: FAQ draft: "Private deployments include customer-managed networking and KMS integrations for audit-ready control."
Ana: for benchmark narrative in the blog/launch post: show an apples-to-apples test vs open-source baseline, highlight batching and caching effects. keep charts in appendix.
Tom: timeline: copy freeze EOD Wed, assets for launch post Thurs, webinar next Tue. anyone blocking?
Sam: need legal to sign off on benchmarking language — I'll ping them now :email:
Maya: thanks. action items:
Maya: - Jules: refine 3 hero options into final hero + 2-line subhead + 1 CTA each (due Tue noon)
Maya: - Ana: write benchmark paragraph + 2 supporting bullets (due Tue EOD)
Maya: - Tom: wireframe micro-CTA placement for each mode and inbound UTMs (due Wed morning)
Maya: - Sam: legal + gating for claims, set up UTM mapping to SFDC (due Wed EOD)
Jules: ack
Ana: ack
Tom: ack
Sam: will follow up with legal convo notes here
LaunchBot: webinar created: "Redwood Inference — Launch Briefing" scheduled 2026-03-31 11:00 PT — registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinar
Maya: perfect. we'll run a dry run Fri. thanks team :tada:
